abrir: abrir + obj (no prep); abrirse a — to open up to.
acabar: acabar de + inf — to have just done; acabar con — to put an end to; acabar por + inf — to end up doing.
aceptar: aceptar + obj / + inf — direct object, no preposition.
alcanzar: alcanzar + obj — to reach; alcanzar a + inf — to manage to do.
almorzar: almorzar + obj — to have (something) for lunch; almorzar con — lunch with.
analizar: analizar + obj — direct object, no preposition.
andar: andar + gerund — to go around doing; andar por — walk around; andar con — hang out with.
anunciar: anunciar algo a alguien — to announce something to someone.
aparecer: aparecer — to appear/show up; aparecer en — appear in/on; aparecerse a — appear to someone.
aprender: aprender a + inf — to learn to; aprender de — to learn from.
arreglar: arreglar algo — to fix/arrange; arreglarse — to get ready.
asistir: asistir a — to attend (an event); note: does NOT mean 'to assist'.
aumentar: aumentar + obj — direct object; aumentar en (amount) — to increase by.
ayudar: ayudar a + person; ayudar a + inf — to help someone do.
bailar: bailar con — to dance with; bailar + style (salsa, tango).
bajar: bajar de — to get off/out of; bajar a — to go down to.
beber: beber + obj — no preposition; beber de — drink from.
borrar: borrar algo — direct object, no preposition.
brillar: brillar — to shine; brillar por su ausencia — conspicuously absent.
buscar: buscar + obj — no 'for' preposition; use personal 'a' for people.
caber: caber en — to fit in; no cabe duda (de) que — there is no doubt that.
caer: caer en — fall on/into; caer bien/mal — to like/dislike someone; caerse — to fall down.
calcular: calcular + obj — direct object, no preposition.
cambiar: cambiar de (tema, ropa, opinión) — to change; cambiar A por B — exchange.
caminar: caminar por — walk through/around; caminar hacia — walk toward.
cantar: cantar + obj — direct object; cantar a alguien — sing to someone.
celebrar: celebrar + obj — to celebrate; celebrar que + subj — to be glad that.
cenar: cenar + obj — to have (something) for dinner; cenar con — dine with.
cerrar: cerrar + obj — to close; cerrarse — to close itself; cerrar con llave — lock.
charlar: charlar con — to chat with; charlar sobre/de — chat about.
cocinar: cocinar + obj — direct object; cocinar para — cook for.
comenzar: comenzar a + inf — to begin/start doing; comenzar por — start by/with.
comer: comer + obj — to eat; comerse algo — to eat it up.
comparar: comparar A con B — compare A with B; comparar A a B — liken A to B.
compartir: compartir algo con alguien — to share something with someone.
comprar: comprar algo a alguien — can mean buy FROM or FOR someone (context).
conducir: conducir + obj — to drive; conducir a — to lead to.
conocer: conocer a — to know/meet a person (personal 'a' always).
conseguir: conseguir + obj — to get/obtain; conseguir + inf — to manage to do.
considerar: considerar + obj/adj — to consider; considerar que + indic — consider that.
construir: construir + obj — direct object, no preposition.
contar: contar algo a alguien — to tell; contar con — to count on; contar hasta — count to.
contestar: contestar a — to answer/reply to; contestar + obj — answer something.
continuar: continuar + gerund — to keep doing; continuar con — continue with.
correr: correr — to run; correr + distance; correr con (gastos) — cover expenses.
crear: crear + obj — direct object, no preposition.
cuidar: cuidar a (persona) / cuidar de — to take care of; cuidarse de — beware of.
dar: dar algo a alguien — to give; darse cuenta de — to realize; dar con — to find/come across.
decidir: decidir + inf — to decide to; decidirse a/por — to make up one's mind.
decir: decir algo a alguien — to tell; decir que + indic (report) / + subj (command).
dejar: dejar de + inf — to stop doing; dejar que + subj — to let; dejar a alguien — leave someone.
descubrir: descubrir + obj — to discover; descubrir que + indic — discover that.
desear: desear + inf / + obj — to wish for; desear que + subj — wish that.
devolver: devolver algo a alguien — to return something to someone.
dibujar: dibujar + obj — direct object; dibujar a alguien — draw someone (personal 'a').
dirigir: dirigir + obj — to direct/manage; dirigirse a — to address/head toward.
discutir: discutir con alguien sobre/de algo — argue with someone about.
dormir: dormir — to sleep; dormirse — to fall asleep.
elegir: elegir + obj — to choose; elegir entre — choose between; elegir a alguien — elect someone.
empezar: empezar a + inf — to start doing; empezar por — start by/with.
encontrar: encontrar + obj — to find; encontrarse con — to meet/run into.
entender: entender + obj — understand; entender de — to know about (topic).
entrar: entrar en (Spain) / entrar a (LatAm) — to enter; entrar por — come in through.
escribir: escribir a alguien — to write to; escribir sobre/de — write about.
escuchar: escuchar + obj — direct object (no 'to'); escuchar a alguien — listen to someone.
estar: estar + adj (temporary) / + location; estar + gerund — progressive; estar de — be in role/mood.
estudiar: estudiar + subject — direct object; estudiar para — study to become.
existir: existir — no direct object; often paired with 'hay' in everyday speech.
explicar: explicar algo a alguien — to explain something to someone.
firmar: firmar + obj — direct object, no preposition.
formar: formar + obj — to form; formar parte de — to be part of; formar a alguien — train someone.
freír: freír + obj — to fry; past participle also 'frito'.
fumar: fumar + obj — direct object, no preposition.
ganar: ganar a alguien — to beat someone; ganar dinero — earn money.
gastar: gastar + amount / gastar en — to spend on.
gritar: gritar a alguien — to shout at; gritar de (dolor) — shout from (pain).
guardar: guardar + obj — to keep/store; guardar silencio — keep silent.
haber: haber + past participle — perfect tenses; hay — there is/are; haber de + inf — mild obligation.
hablar: hablar con — speak with; hablar de/sobre — speak about; hablar + language — speak (Spanish).
hacer: hacer + obj — to do/make; hace + time + que — (ago); hacerse + noun/adj — to become.
huir: huir de — to flee from; huir hacia — flee toward.
imaginar: imaginar(se) + obj/clause — to imagine; imagínate que — imagine that.
imprimir: imprimir + obj — direct object, no preposition.
incluir: incluir + obj — direct object; incluir a alguien — include someone (personal 'a').
insistir: insistir en — to insist on; insistir en que + subj — insist that.
intentar: intentar + inf — to try to; intentar + obj — to attempt.
invitar: invitar a alguien a + inf / + event — invite someone to.
ir: ir a + inf — near future; ir a + place — go to; ir en (car/bus) — go by; irse — to leave.
jugar: jugar a + sport/game (Spain); jugar + sport (LatAm); jugar con — play with.
lavar: lavar + obj — to wash; lavarse + body part — reflexive for body parts.
levantar: levantar algo — to lift; levantarse — to get up / stand up.
limpiar: limpiar + obj — direct object, no preposition.
llamar: llamar a alguien — to call someone (personal 'a'); llamarse — to be named.
llegar: llegar a — to arrive at; llegar a + inf — to manage to; llegar tarde — arrive late.
llorar: llorar por — cry over/for; llorar de (emoción) — cry from (emotion).
lograr: lograr + obj / + inf — to achieve/manage to; lograr que + subj — manage to get someone/something to.
mantener: mantener + obj — to maintain; mantenerse + adj — to stay/keep oneself.
mentir: mentir a alguien — to lie to; mentir sobre/en — lie about.
mirar: mirar + obj — to look at (no preposition); mirar a alguien — look at someone.
morir: morir de — to die of/from; morirse por — be dying to / for.
nadar: nadar + style (crol); nadar en — swim in.
notar: notar + obj — to notice; notar que + indic — notice that.
observar: observar + obj — direct object; observar a alguien — observe someone.
ocurrir: ocurrir — to happen (impersonal); ocurrírsele a alguien — to occur to someone.
olvidar: olvidar(se) de — to forget about; olvidar + inf — forget to.
organizar: organizar + obj — direct object, no preposition.
oír: oír + obj — to hear (no 'to'); oír hablar de — hear about.
pagar: pagar algo — pay something; pagar por — pay for; pagarle a alguien — pay someone.
participar: participar en — to participate in; participar de — share in.
pasar: pasar por — pass by/through; pasar de — not care about; pasar a + inf — go on to do.
pedir: pedir algo (no prep) — ask for; pedir a alguien que + subj — ask someone to.
pensar: pensar en — think about (someone/something); pensar de — think of (opinion); pensar + inf — plan to.
perder: perder + obj — to lose; perderse — to get lost; perder de vista — lose sight of.
poder: poder + inf — to be able to; no poder con — can't stand/handle.
poner: poner + obj — to put; ponerse + adj — to become; ponerse a + inf — start to.
preferir: preferir + obj/inf — prefer; preferir A a B — prefer A over B.
preguntar: preguntar a alguien — ask someone; preguntar por — ask about/for (a person).
preparar: preparar + obj — direct object; prepararse para — get ready to.
presentar: presentar a alguien — introduce someone; presentarse a — show up to.
proponer: proponer + inf / que + subj — to propose; proponerse + inf — set out to.
publicar: publicar + obj — direct object, no preposition.
quedar: quedar con — to meet up with; quedar en + inf — to agree to; quedarse — to stay.
querer: querer + inf — want to; querer a — love (personal 'a'); querer que + subj — want someone to.
realizar: realizar + obj — to carry out (NOT 'to realize' — use darse cuenta).
recibir: recibir + obj — direct object, no preposition.
recordar: recordar + obj — to remember; recordarle a alguien — to remind someone.
repetir: repetir + obj — to repeat, no preposition.
reservar: reservar + obj — direct object; reservar para — reserve for.
responder: responder a — to respond to; responder con — respond with.
resultar: resultar + adj — to turn out/be; resultar que — it turns out that; resultar en — result in.
reunir: reunir — to gather; reunirse con — to meet with.
reír: reírse de — to laugh at; reír con — laugh with.
saber: saber + inf — to know how to; saber a — to taste like; saber de — know about.
sacar: sacar + obj — to take out; sacar algo de — take out from; sacar una foto — take a photo.
salir: salir de — to leave from; salir con — to go out with/date; salir a + inf — go out to.
saludar: saludar a alguien — to greet (personal 'a' required).
satisfacer: satisfacer + obj — to satisfy; conjugates like hacer (satisfago, satisfice).
seguir: seguir + gerund — to keep doing; seguir a alguien — to follow (personal 'a').
sentir: sentir + obj / que — to feel/be sorry; sentirse + adj — to feel (emotion).
separar: separar A de B — to separate A from B.
ser: ser + noun/adj — identity/essential quality; ser de — be from / made of / belong to.
servir: servir para — to be used for; servir a alguien — to serve; servirse de — make use of.
subir: subir a — to get on/go up to; subir por — go up via.
sufrir: sufrir de — to suffer from; sufrir + obj — to suffer (consequences).
suspirar: suspirar por — to long for / sigh for.
tener: tener + obj — to have; tener que + inf — have to; tener ganas de — feel like.
terminar: terminar de + inf — to finish doing; terminar con alguien — break up with.
tocar: tocar + instrument — to play; tocarle a alguien — to be someone's turn.
tomar: tomar + obj — to take/have (drink); tomar en cuenta — take into account.
trabajar: trabajar en — work at/in; trabajar de/como — work as; trabajar con — work with.
traer: traer + obj — to bring; traer algo a alguien — bring someone something.
tratar: tratar de + inf — to try to; tratar a alguien — to treat someone; tratarse de — to be about.
unir: unir A con B — to unite; unirse a — to join.
usar: usar + obj — direct object, no preposition.
utilizar: utilizar + obj — to use; more formal than usar.
vender: vender algo a alguien — to sell something to someone.
venir: venir a + inf — come to do; venir de — come from; venir con — come with.
ver: ver + obj — to see (personal 'a' with people); verse con — to meet with.
viajar: viajar a — travel to; viajar por — travel through; viajar en (coche) — travel by.
visitar: visitar a alguien — to visit someone (personal 'a').
vivir: vivir en — to live in; vivir de — live off/on; vivir con — live with.
volar: volar a — fly to; volar por — fly over/through.
volver: volver a + inf — to do again; volver de — come back from; volverse + adj — to become.
